P_calibration.quote: A court or prosecutor could read "single training run" or "purpose of safety evaluation" purposively, and structuring conduct around a pretextual reading is the fact pattern that supports willfulness under §5(b).

P_grandfather_step.quote: Runs begun in that window are neither exempt nor (yet) unlawful; whether continuing such a run after the effective date is a violation depends on whether "train" is a continuing act, which the bill does not say.

P_reliance_caveat.quote: relying on them as a compliance strategy carries its own risk.
